Enum Class LabourInsight

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<LabourInsight>
com.example.personalityquest.Model.quest.LabourInsight
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<LabourInsight>, Constable
public enum LabourInsight extends Enum<LabourInsight>
Hardcoded "Theme" and "Growth" copy shown on the Quest Viewer's "Why this Quest?" cover page. Not persisted to the database - entries line up 1:1 with the labourId values seeded by QuestDAO (which in turn match the twelve Archetype ids).
